products.name: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) — Endpoint, Cloud & Email — Commercial
products.short_description: Implement Purview DLP across endpoint, cloud, and email — sensitive info types + classifiers, policies for Exchange/SPO/OneDrive/Teams/Endpoint (simulated first), policy tips, and incident handling — so leaks are blocked with minimal false positives. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stop sensitive data leaving — across endpoints, cloud, and email

Sensitive data walks out through email, cloud sharing, and USB/print on endpoints. This solution implements Purview DLP across the estate: sensitive information types (built-in, custom, EDM, trainable classifiers), DLP policies for Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, and Endpoint (devices), policy tips + user overrides, incident/alert handling, and tuning — all piloted in simulation before enforcement, so leaks are blocked with minimal false positives.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the DLP model: sensitive info types + classifiers, policy locations (email/cloud/Teams/Endpoint), policy tips/overrides, and the simulate→enforce journey.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (E5/E5 Compliance for endpoint DLP, roles, onboarded devices, classification, stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — define sensitive info types/classifiers, build DLP policies per location in simulation, tune false positives, add policy tips + overrides, wire incident handling, then enforce — pilot-first, each policy named.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation, Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — authentic Security & Compliance PowerShell / Graph automation (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Validation gates (leaks blocked, false-positive rate low, incidents handled) plus Best Practices for ongoing DLP tuning across endpoint/cloud/email.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Sensitive data kept in — DLP across email, cloud, Teams, and endpoints, proven in simulation, tuned for low false positives, incidents handled — leaks blocked without blocking the business.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • PURVDLP-Config.ps1 — DLP policy configuration helper that creates/updates a policy in SIMULATION mode (-WhatIf by default)
    • PURVDLP-Discovery.ps1 — read-only Microsoft Purview DLP posture + sensitive-info-type coverage assessment
    • PURVDLP-EndpointReadiness.ps1 — read-only Endpoint-DLP onboarding/readiness checker
    • PURVDLP-Report.ps1 — read-only DLP match / false-positive tuning report from the unified audit log
    • PURVDLP-Set-Scope.ps1 — DLP policy scope/config helper: report and (with -Commit) set the pilot-ring scope (-WhatIf by default)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
